item.title: Apple’s ‘Welcome Home’ Event: New Hub, TV & Mini
item.description: Apple’s Oct 13 ‘Welcome Home’ event in New York will unveil a smart‑home hub, Apple TV and HomePod mini, while the touchscreen MacBook arrives later.
